fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_IDLE
fsm_states_transmitter.description: SOUT HIGH; THR + TX FIFO empty; THRE=1, TEMT=1.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_START_BIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive SOUT LOW for 1 bit-time (start bit).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_DATA_BITS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Shift out 5-8 data bits LSB-first on SOUT, one bit per BAUDOUT/16 cycle.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_PARITY_BIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive parity bit (even / odd / mark / space) if PEN=1.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_STOP_BITS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive SOUT HIGH for 1, 1.5, or 2 stop bit-times.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_BREAK
fsm_states_transmitter.description: While LCR.BREAK=1: hold SOUT LOW continuously.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_START_BIT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Re-sample SIN mid-bit (8 clocks into the bit cell) to confirm valid start; false start-bit detection.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_DATA_BITS
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample SIN mid-bit (every 16th BAUDOUT) and shift into receive shift register LSB-first.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_PARITY_BIT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample parity bit (if PEN=1) and compare to expected parity.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_STOP_BITS
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample stop bit(s); if 0 then FE=1.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_TRANSFER
fsm_states_receiver.description: Move received character + error bits into RBR (char mode) or RX FIFO (FIFO mode); set DR=1.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_BREAK_DET
fsm_states_receiver.description: SIN held LOW for ≥ entire character time → BI=1.

fsm_hints.tx_trigger: CPU write to THR (char mode) or push into TX FIFO (FIFO mode) starts a transfer cycle.
fsm_hints.rx_trigger: SIN HIGH→LOW transition starts a receive cycle.
fsm_hints.oversampling: Receiver samples each bit at the 8th of 16 BAUDOUT clocks; mid-bit sampling for noise immunity.
fsm_hints.abort_conditions: Master Reset (MR HIGH); a configuration change to LCR/MCR/baud divisor while a frame is in progress will corrupt the frame.
fsm_hints.central_role: Initiates the connection (Initiating state → Connection state). Schedules and starts each connection event by transmitting the first LL Data PDU. Manages Channel Map updates, Connection Parameter updates, Encryption setup, PHY Update, CIS creation.
fsm_hints.peripheral_role: Advertises in Advertising state; accepts CONNECT_IND from an Initiator. Once in Connection state, listens at each anchor for the Central's PDU and responds. May reject parameter updates by issuing LL_REJECT_IND or LL_REJECT_EXT_IND.
fsm_hints.advertiser_role: Broadcaster — transmits advertising PDUs without expectation of a response (ADV_NONCONN_IND / ADV_SCAN_IND); cycles through channels 37/38/39 per advertising event.
fsm_hints.scanner_role: Observer — passive scan listens for broadcast packets; active scan additionally sends SCAN_REQ to elicit a SCAN_RSP carrying extra data.
fsm_hints.rule: The Link Layer FSM is one-of-six (Standby / Advertising / Scanning / Initiating / Connection / Synchronization); state transitions are triggered by HCI commands (LE Set Advertising Enable / LE Set Scan Enable / LE Create Connection / LE Periodic Advertising Create Sync / LE Set Extended Advertising Enable / LE Disconnect) and by Link-Layer procedures (CONNECT_IND received, supervision timeout).

anti_deadlock_rule: Each connection event has a Connection Event Length budget; if both ends exhaust the budget the event ends and the next event resumes at the next anchor. Supervision Timeout (100 ms..32 s) bounds maximum link-loss detection latency; on expiry the Link Layer drops to Standby and signals HCI Disconnection Complete to the host.
exit_from_reset: After Master Reset (MR=1 for ≥ 1 µs): all registers (except RBR/THR/DLL/DLM) cleared; SOUT, INTR, OUT1, OUT2, RTS, DTR set per Table I. Software must program DLL/DLM (baud) and LCR (framing) before transmission begins.

default_ready_state_recommendation.Modem_outputs_idle: All HIGH (inactive) after MR; software writes MCR to assert.
default_ready_state_recommendation.radio_off: Radio powered down to save energy; controller in Standby.
default_ready_state_recommendation.advertising: Cycle through channels 37/38/39 every advertising interval; reset interval timer on each event.
default_ready_state_recommendation.scanning: Switch RX channel per scan window / scan interval; passive scan does not transmit.
default_ready_state_recommendation.connection_event: Central starts event on the scheduled channel per Channel Selection Algorithm #1 or #2; Peripheral listens at the same channel; both ends use the same hop sequence.

behavior: Transmitter SOUT is set to HIGH-Z and internally connected to receiver SIN.
Modem inputs CTS, DSR, DCD, RI are disconnected from pins; driven instead by MCR bits 0-3 (DTR→DSR, RTS→CTS, OUT1→RI, OUT2→DCD).
Allows software self-test without external loopback.

false_start_bit_detection: On SIN HIGH→LOW edge, receiver waits 8 BAUDOUT clocks (half a bit time) and re-samples; if SIN is still LOW, accept as start bit. Otherwise discard as noise.
interrupt_priority_order: 2: Received Data Available (or FIFO trigger level reached)

device_visible_states.name: Attached
device_visible_states.description: Device powered (VBUS), but not yet seen by host (D± pull-up not yet asserted).

device_visible_states.name: Powered
device_visible_states.description: Device asserts speed-identification pull-up; host detects connect.

device_visible_states.name: Default
device_visible_states.description: After USB Reset; device responds to address 0.

device_visible_states.name: Address
device_visible_states.description: Device has been assigned a unique 7-bit address (1..127) via SET_ADDRESS request.

device_visible_states.name: Configured
device_visible_states.description: Device has accepted a SET_CONFIGURATION request with a non-zero configuration value; endpoints other than EP0 are usable.

device_visible_states.name: Suspended
device_visible_states.description: Bus idle > 3 ms; device must reduce VBUS current to ≤ 500 µA.

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After radio reset the Link Layer is in Standby. The host issues HCI Reset, then LE Set Random Address / LE Set Advertising Parameters / LE Set Advertising Enable (to advertise) or LE Set Scan Parameters / LE Set Scan Enable (to scan) or LE Create Connection (to initiate). For BLE 5 extended use, LE Set Extended Advertising Parameters / LE Set Extended Advertising Data / LE Set Extended Advertising Enable are used instead.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: ACK
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: Packet accepted without error; data successfully received.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: NAK
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: Device not ready; host may retry later.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: STALL
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: Endpoint is halted; host must clear ENDPOINT_HALT feature to recover.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: NYET
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: (HS only) Data accepted, but next will likely NAK; used with PING flow control.

handshake_packet_meanings.name: NRDY
handshake_packet_meanings.meaning: (HS only) Device not ready (used in PING context).

data_toggle_rule: Endpoint maintains a toggle bit (DATA0 ↔ DATA1) per pipe; transmitter alternates after each ACKed packet; receiver only accepts the expected toggle. SETUP token always forces DATA0; STALL preserves toggle.
split_transaction_rule: USB 2.0 hub bridging HS upstream to FS/LS downstream issues Start-Split (SSPLIT) at the HS side, the hub then performs the FS/LS transaction on its own clock, and the host later issues Complete-Split (CSPLIT) to retrieve the result.

fsm_states_transceiver_half_duplex.name: TXR_DISABLED
fsm_states_transceiver_half_duplex.description: DE=0, RE#=1 — both driver and receiver tri-stated; transceiver in shutdown/low-power.

fsm_states_transceiver_half_duplex.name: TXR_RX_ONLY
fsm_states_transceiver_half_duplex.description: DE=0, RE#=0 — driver tri-stated, receiver enabled. R = digital reflection of V_AB.

fsm_states_transceiver_half_duplex.name: TXR_TX_ONLY
fsm_states_transceiver_half_duplex.description: DE=1, RE#=1 — driver enabled, receiver tri-stated (or echo-disabled). Bus driven differentially based on D input.

fsm_states_transceiver_half_duplex.name: TXR_TX_AND_LOOPBACK
fsm_states_transceiver_half_duplex.description: DE=1, RE#=0 — both enabled; receiver echoes the transmitted bit back to R (useful for half-duplex collision detection).

fsm_states_bus_logical.name: BUS_IDLE
fsm_states_bus_logical.description: No driver enabled; differential bus voltage near zero unless failsafe biasing pulls V_AB > +200 mV → all receivers see R = HIGH (mark).

fsm_states_bus_logical.name: BUS_MARK
fsm_states_bus_logical.description: Active driver pulls V_AB > +200 mV → all receivers see R = HIGH (logical 1).

fsm_states_bus_logical.name: BUS_SPACE
fsm_states_bus_logical.description: Active driver pulls V_AB < -200 mV → all receivers see R = LOW (logical 0).

fsm_states_bus_logical.name: BUS_CONTENTION
fsm_states_bus_logical.description: Two or more drivers enabled simultaneously — bus current spikes; data corrupted; relies on driver short-circuit current limit to avoid damage. MUST be prevented by software.

failsafe_biasing_modes.internal_failsafe: Built into modern transceivers; covers open-circuit / short-circuit / idle-bus; worst-case noise margin ≈ 10 mV.
failsafe_biasing_modes.external_failsafe: Resistive divider on each bus end (R_B in series with R_T); engineered for V_AB ≥ 200 mV + V_noise; restores robust noise margin.

isolation_recommendations: When ground-potential difference (GPD) may approach the -7 V to +12 V common-mode range, insert galvanic isolation (digital isolator + isolated DC/DC).
Direct connection of remote grounds via ground wire is NOT recommended (causes large ground-loop currents).
Resistor-bonded ground separation reduces loop current but leaves the link sensitive to induced noise.
Full signal + supply isolation provides multi-kilovolt GPD tolerance and is the recommended long-distance robust topology.

advertising_pdu_relationships.name: ADV_IND
advertising_pdu_relationships.rule: Connectable + scannable undirected advertising; any scanner may issue SCAN_REQ; any initiator may issue CONNECT_IND.

advertising_pdu_relationships.name: ADV_DIRECT_IND
advertising_pdu_relationships.rule: Connectable directed advertising; only the InitA target may respond with CONNECT_IND; high-duty-cycle mode for fast reconnect.

advertising_pdu_relationships.name: ADV_NONCONN_IND
advertising_pdu_relationships.rule: Non-connectable + non-scannable; broadcast only; iBeacon / Eddystone use this.

advertising_pdu_relationships.name: ADV_SCAN_IND
advertising_pdu_relationships.rule: Scannable non-connectable; scanner may issue SCAN_REQ for SCAN_RSP extra data.

advertising_pdu_relationships.name: ADV_EXT_IND
advertising_pdu_relationships.rule: Extended advertising primary; AdvData may be empty or point to AUX_ADV_IND via AuxPtr.

advertising_pdu_relationships.name: AUX_ADV_IND
advertising_pdu_relationships.rule: Auxiliary advertising on a data channel carrying the bulk of extended advertising data.

advertising_pdu_relationships.name: AUX_SYNC_IND
advertising_pdu_relationships.rule: Periodic Advertising broadcast on data channels at the periodic interval; no scan / connect handshake.

data_channel_index_rule: During a connection (or Periodic Advertising sync), the channel for the next event is computed by Channel Selection Algorithm #1 (sequential ring) or #2 (BLE 5 deterministic permutation with anti-collision); bad channels in the Channel Map are skipped, and the event uses the next good channel in the sequence.
supervision_timeout_rule: If no valid CRC-passing PDU is received within the Supervision Timeout window (100 ms..32 s, 10 ms steps, must exceed (1 + Slave Latency) * Connection Interval * 2), the Link Layer terminates the connection and signals Disconnection Complete to the host.
